title: 2021 Panini Playoff Football Kadarius Toney Rookie Wave Base Card RW-KTO
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2021 Panini Playoff Football card features Kadarius Toney, a rookie player from the National Football League (NFL) team, New York Giants. The card is an original and licensed reprint with a Rookie Wave parallel/variety and an English language.

The card's name is "Kadarius Toney" and it belongs to the 2021 Panini Playoff set. The card number is RW-KTO. The card is a standard size and was manufactured in the United States. It is a sports trading card of the football sport and is an insert with features like Rookie.
